summary:
Complete worked solutions to all 38 questions of the Class XII Mathematics Half-Yearly Examination 2026-27, covering:

- Section A: 20 MCQs on relations, functions, inverse trigonometry, matrices, determinants, continuity, differentiation, integration, and assertion-reason questions
- Section B: 5 short-answer questions (2 marks each)
- Section C: 6 medium-answer questions (3 marks each) including proofs and computations
- Section D: 4 long-answer questions (5 marks each) including matrix method for linear systems, second derivative proof, optimization, and integration with partial fractions
- Section E: 3 case-based questions (4 marks each) on equivalence relations, marginal cost, and kinematics
